main_text.l: Perpetuus sedet arce Rector. Non replet illam Fors animantium Tot vana formis, aut species parit Totmanca[?] diuisas, suisq; Cuncta[?] cibis animata nutrit. Quæ rura messes lætificas ferunt, Et pictavernis[?] prata coloribus, Hortíque diuersis comantes Arboribus, viridésque sylvæ: Feruente pigrum quæ fugit otium Æstate, magnis atque laboribus Formica solers ore paruo Grana vehit tenuémque victum: Quæ mella condunt dulcia cellulis, Mitésque succos floribus auferunt Apes odoratis, suíque Iussa Ducis faciles sequuntur. Hæc cuncta clamant verticibus poli Sedere celsis Cœlituum patrem: Terrásque cunctas atque Gentes Mente regi Superûmque cura. Idémque clamant flumina, quæ rigant Distincta terras, regnáque diuidunt, Vrbésque circundant, & agros Flexiuago sinuosa cursu. Sic curua clamant littora: quæ ferox Æquor coercent, quum tumet horridis Auctum procellis, nauibúsque

page.notes: The verse is printed in lines with indentation but no visible stanza breaks, so it is given as one paragraph. "Totmanca" and "Cuncta" are tight in the print and may read "Tot manca" and "Cuncta"; the [?] marks them. "pictavernis" is doubtful: it could be "pictaque vernis", as the print is faint. Some accents on "Superûmque", "Idémque", "Mitésque" and "Vrbésque" are as printed and may be ink spots; they are copied as seen.
